description: Machine-readable configuration for the self-tcb-reduction Squeeze Loop: convert the self-annotation mirror's ~1290 \trusted stubs to verified body-faithful methods, driving the trusted core to its irreducible floor. Companion: config/skills/self-tcb-reduction/SKILL.md and self-tcb-reduction.md.
deliverable: src/self-annotate/src/ with the \trusted-stub count reduced to the enumerated floor; every .py stub either VERIFIED or FLOOR-audited with a reason.
correct_means: mirror body verbatim-identical to the live emitter method (fidelity)
byte-diff 0 across the 627-program reference corpus (corpus inertness)

coherent_and_wrong_guards.risk: a stub verifies a STALE copy no longer matching the live emitter
a recognizer added to pass one stub silently changes real-program output
a convertible stub is mislabelled 'irreducible floor' to skip the work
a stub 'verified' by an added axiom or a loose assigns
coherent_and_wrong_guards.caught_by: Gate B (proof_axiom_allowlist diff) + Gate C (non-vacuity / tight assigns)

sources: the live emitter method in src/pycsl/ (verbatim transcription source)
fixed contract shape: '#@ requires True / ensures True / assigns <tight-frame>' (type-safety + frame; NEVER value-faithful; NEVER vacuous)
item-3 ceiling doctrine (remaining-trust.md, item34.md §1) bounding what may be re-sited to the floor

planes.verdict: mirror body == live body, verbatim modulo #@
byte-diff 0 AND suite no-new-fail AND \trusted count strictly decreased

actors.builds: tier work-list, per-stub delegation, gate verdicts, the shrinking-count ledger
the verbatim mirror body + the assigns-framed #@ + any @mutable_state-gated recognizer in the LIVE emitter
actors.U: the live emitter method + the fixed contract shape
forbidden: touch the corpus baseline or the floor-audit

actors.builds: runs the three L planes fresh from the surface only; authors the non-vacuity + non-drift checks
actors.U: the plan's gate battery + the contract shape
actors.L: the actual oracle verdicts (sync exit, diff -rq, proof, wc -l, suite)
must_not_see: the converter's diffs (surface + gate results only)

actors.builds: a PASS/REJECT verdict on every re-siting of a stub to F1/F3
actors.L: the floor register + a differential (did a genuine conversion attempt actually fail?)

actors.builds: one recorded classification per stub: trivial-leaf | needs-recognizer | hard-architectural | floor
actors.L: the stub's actual shape (does --no-proof pass as-is?)

disjointness_C1: converter holds live-emitter + type-check (never corpus baseline or ceiling doctrine); verifier holds acceptance oracles (never code rationale); floor-auditor holds ceiling doctrine (never convenience motive). No actor relieves its own constraint. Intersection = verbatim-faithful AND type-safe AND corpus-inert AND (if re-sited) genuinely irreducible.

gates.A_editorial: coordinator judges the delegation — right tier, NOT on the floor denylist, contract shape correct (type-safety+frame; not value-faithful; not vacuous). Amend/cut/sharpen; no mirror edit from a DRAFT.
gates.B_machine: all three L planes pass (fidelity AND type-safety AND corpus-inertness incl. strictly-decreased count); nothing smuggled (no added axiom/assumes).
gates.C_coverage_no_blend: the three planes never blend; non-vacuity (tight assigns; real transcribed body, not a stub); every re-sited stub carries a floor-auditor PASS; every touched stub ends VERIFIED or FLOOR:{F1|F3}+reason (none TRUSTED-unclassified).

loop_steps: coordinator picks next stub from the current tier work-list (skip floor denylist), delegates surface-only
converter ports live body verbatim + #@ contract + recognizers, runs --no-proof @ STATUS: DRAFT
converter removes \trusted marker, commits the increment
verifier runs the three L planes fresh (sync, proof, byte-diff 0, suite, count)
Gate B (machine) -> Gate C (no-blend + non-vacuity + floor-audit if re-sited)
stub DONE -> next; attempt-budget exceeded -> revert + floor-auditor triage (hard-architectural=flag focused pass | genuine floor=re-site); regression -> gap doc -> re-plan

escalation.on_exceed: revert stub; floor-auditor triages hard-architectural (flag for focused high-reasoning pass, e.g. match-class) vs genuine-floor (re-site with reason)
escalation.no_progress_termination: 2 consecutive no-progress iterations -> re-site residual with floor-auditor sign-off

F1_recursion_leaves: <any mutually-recursive emitter sibling bottoming out in these>
floor_denylist.F2_D2_axioms: the 37 axioms in src/self-annotate/pycsl-wp-spec.mlw (audited by I3.1; not .py stubs)
floor_denylist.F3_opaque_boundaries: methods whose faithful contract needs an external/undecidable surface (SMT invocation, CLI file I/O, why3 subprocess, agents/ LLM calls) -> \abstract/\trusted with a documented boundary, never a fake axiom

subtiers.scope: Module 6 emitter helpers (types, functions, preamble, ir_scanner, abstract_ops, auto_trust, identifiers, scc, struct_format, expr_ghost_*)
subtiers.order: dependency order (a verified handler's callees first)

tiers.note: spike one method to fix the pattern, then batch

tiers.scope: front-end pipeline (frontend/: pure_ast, Module5_IREmitter, Module2_Parser, Module3_Weaver, monomorphize, ir_resolve, Module1_Ingestor, ir_inline)
tiers.note: Layer-2 re-checks emitted WhyML on every run, so a front-end defect cannot pass silently; leaf-first
default to documented boundary, not conversion; convert only on demand

oracle_setup.E-0_baseline: pin the clean-tree byte-diff baseline once (stash local edits, sweep clean HEAD, restore); every stub diffs against it
oracle_setup.amortization: type-check per stub (--no-proof, fast); batch full proof + byte-diff per FILE, not per stub

stabilizers: vacuous/weak-contract -> Gate C non-vacuity + fixed shape
mirror-drift -> physical fidelity gate (converter never owns the sync verdict)
smuggled-axiom -> proof_axiom_allowlist diff in Gate B
reclassification-dodge -> independent floor-auditor with ceiling doctrine as U
plane-blending -> Gate C requires all three planes
unsequenced-parallelism -> sequential per-file (shared recognizers); parallel only the triage probe
escalate-not-thrash -> per-stub attempt budget; flag the hard tail
done_criteria: every mirror .py stub is VERIFIED or FLOOR:{F1|F3}+reason; \trusted wc -l at the enumerated floor; check-self-annotate-sync.sh AND self-annotate-mirror-check.sh AND run-self-annotation-suite.sh green; byte-diff 0 throughout; proof_axiom_allowlist unchanged.
start_scope: E-0 baseline -> T1.a (24 expression handlers, read-only first)
